title: Confinement in Holographic Theories at Finite Theta
summary: A strongly coupled confining gauge theory with a non-zero vacuum angle undergoing a deconfinement to confinement phase transition is studied in the holographic gravitational description. A simplified five-dimensional setup is constructed where a bulk scalar models the effect of the vacuum angle, and the suitable boundary conditions on the ultra-violet (UV) and the infra-red (IR) boundaries are identified.
